create_calendar: create a new user calendar with a name and color via the calendar router
get_events_in_range: get calendar events within a date range and expand recurring events using RRULE
create_calendar_event: create a new calendar event with title, start time, and optional attendees
rsvp_to_event: update your RSVP status for a calendar event to accepted, declined, or tentative
delete_calendar: delete a user calendar by ID after verifying write access and ownership
